title: What breaks the rules of the spreadsheet?
instruction: New rows have been added to the table of loans. Mark the ones that break the rules for entries.
debrief: One format, no duplicates and required fields. Only then can the app reliably filter, sort and count.

items.why: “Tomorrow” is not a date. In a week nobody knows when it was.

items.text: Oliver Smith · The Hobbit · 3 Nov 2026 · no, when Ollie is already in the table
items.why: One pupil under two names: the app turns him into two people.

items.text: (no name) · The Little Prince · 4 Nov 2026 · no
items.why: A required field is missing. Who has the book?

items.text: Emma · The Little Prince · 4 Nov 2026 · no
items.why: All the details in the right format.

items.text: Eva · The Hobbit · 5 Nov 2026 · yes, note empty
items.why: The note is not required, it may be empty.
“the hobbit” and “The Hobbit” are two different books for the app.
